Onikuma MP006 RGB Gaming Mouse Pad XL (800 x 300 x 4 mm / 12 Lighting Modes / Black)

Light up your desktop layout and elevate your targeting performance with the Onikuma MP006 RGB gaming mouse pad, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring an expansive extra-large surface measuring 800x300mm and a plush 4mm comfort thickness profile, this premium desk pad offers ample space to accommodate both your full-sized keyboard and mouse setup, making it a dream configuration for low-DPI gaming. It boasts built-in customizable RGB LED lighting wraps with 12 distinct lighting mode effects—including vibrant dynamic breathing cycles and static monochrome colors—easily managed via a dedicated physical switch button on the control hub. The surface is crafted from a high-quality micro-textured waterproof fabric framework that ensures pixel-perfect sensor tracking while shielding your setup from accidental liquid spills. Backed by a high-grip natural rubber base layout and secured by thick stitched border graphics to prevent wear and tear, this Black RGB pad delivers unmatched desk stability and aesthetics.
